thesis.title: HISTORICAL PRELIMINARY — NVDA Q2 FY2025 disclosure-only screen pass (not a recommendation)
thesis.thesis: HISTORICAL PRELIMINARY RESEARCH NOTE — not a live investment recommendation and not a ranking. In a frozen, offline, disclosure-only screen (fixture SEC-DISCLOSURE-SINGLETON-PANEL-v1, run as_of 2026-10-21T18:58:13Z) using only two disclosed criteria — GAAP gross margin >= 40% and reported revenue YoY >= 0% — NVIDIA Corporation (NVDA) was retained as the single candidate. Per the Q2 FY2025 press release filed 2024-08-28 for the period ended 2024-07-28, NVIDIA reported GAAP revenue of USD 30,040 million, revenue growth of 122% YoY, GAAP gross margin of 75.1%, and Data Center revenue of approximately USD 26,300 million (rounded), up 154% YoY. Both screen criteria were satisfied with wide margin. This note records only that the disclosed historical figures cleared a narrow two-metric gate; it contains no price, valuation, analyst-target, or forward-return input, and the screen explicitly excluded those dimensions. No conclusion about whether NVDA shares are attractively valued, and no buy/sell/hold view, is expressed or implied. The source date is a single historical filing date and must not be treated as contemporaneous with any other issuer's data or as a common-date ranking.
assumptions: The screen's retained result rests solely on two disclosed GAAP metrics (gross margin >= 40%, revenue YoY >= 0%) from a single historical filing; it is not evidence of durable competitive advantage or future performance.
Reported figures are taken as disclosed in the Q2 FY2025 press release for the period ended 2024-07-28 and are not independently recomputed or restated.
Data Center revenue of ~USD 26,300 million is a rounded disclosure and is treated as approximate.
catalysts: Future SEC filings disclosing updated GAAP gross margin and revenue growth (not part of this historical case).
invalidations: A later filing showing GAAP gross margin below 40% or reported revenue YoY below 0% would break the two criteria this historical screen relied on.
Evidence that the cited press release figures were restated or superseded would invalidate the recorded numbers.

# Historical Disclosure-Only Candidate Research — NVDA

**Scope note:** This is a frozen, offline, historical disclosure-only screen (`SEC-DISCLOSURE-SINGLETON-PANEL-v1`, `offline_frozen_adapter: true`, `not_live_market_data: true`). It is **not** a live investment recommendation, not a ranking, and not a common-date comparison. No trades were placed and no live market tools were called.

## 1. Screen run
- Tool: `finance-tools__screen_stocks`, market US, symbol NVDA, `require_complete=false`
- Run as_of: 2026-10-21T18:58:13Z (request_id `67412cd0-f0d0-449e-b7cf-362e90a6cb89`)
- Criteria applied (only these two): GAAP gross margin ≥ 40%; reported revenue YoY ≥ 0%
- Excluded dimensions: share price, valuation, analyst target, forward return
- Result: **passed 1, failed 0**; retained = NVDA; rejected = none
- Quality: completeness 0.9667, no flags

## 2. Retained result — NVIDIA Corporation (NVDA)
| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Reporting period | Q2 FY2025, ended 2024-07-28 |
| Filing date | 2024-08-28 |
| Accounting basis | US GAAP |
| GAAP revenue | USD 30,040 million |
| Revenue YoY | +122% |
| GAAP gross margin | 75.1% |
| GAAP gross margin QoQ change | −3.3 percentage points |
| Data Center revenue | ~USD 26,300 million (rounded), +154% YoY |
| Locators | "Q2 Fiscal 2025 Summary"; "Data Center highlights" |
| Source URL | https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581024000262/q2fy25pr.htm |
| Full SHA-256 | `0ab67703a5fb0def7eeb220475bc55e8bb8ab595c5a74103437acda3b1f57dbc` |

**Failed criteria:** none — both criteria cleared with wide margin (75.1% vs. 40% floor; +122% vs. 0% floor).

## 3. Rejected results
None. The screen returned an empty `rejected` array, so there are no failed-criteria records to report.

## 4. Countervailing risks and boundaries
- **Margin trajectory:** GAAP gross margin declined 3.3 pp sequentially despite strong revenue growth — the screen's margin test is a level test, not a trend test, so this deterioration is not captured by the pass.
- **Rounded disclosure:** Data Center revenue is disclosed as an approximate (~USD 26,300M) figure.
- **Missing price/valuation boundary:** No share price, valuation multiple, analyst target, or forward-return input exists in this case. Nothing here speaks to whether NVDA shares are attractively valued.
- **Single-source, single-date:** One historical filing date; not contemporaneous with any other issuer's data and not a common-date ranking.
- **Narrow gate:** Two disclosed metrics only; passing them is not evidence of durable advantage or future performance.

## 5. Thesis saved
Exactly one thesis was created (status `researching`, conviction 1, no `next_review_at` set since no future review date was specified):
- ID: `th_4cdfe88a10964459988f` — "HISTORICAL PRELIMINARY — NVDA Q2 FY2025 disclosure-only screen pass (not a recommendation)"
- Structured evidence includes the full SEC URL, full SHA-256, filing date, period, GAAP basis, units, reported metrics, locators, and the risk note; a second evidence entry records the screen run parameters and excluded dimensions.
- Required event metrics recorded: `gaap_gross_margin_percent`, `revenue_yoy_percent`.

No buy/sell/hold view, price target, or valuation conclusion is expressed or implied.
